Bow Wow is such a lovely dog grooming and pet store in the heart of London. The team are incredibly warm, knowledgeable and clearly experienced, especially when it comes to grooming Asian dog breeds.

I have a Pekingese and bring him here regularly for grooming. I honestly didn’t think he could get any more handsome or cute, but every time he comes out after his grooming appointment, he somehow becomes exactly that!! They really understand how to groom his breed properly while keeping his look natural, beautiful and full of fluff.

The staff are always so kind, patient and professional, and you can tell they genuinely care about the dogs they look after. Such a wonderful place and one I’d happily recommend to any dog owner.

OMG I’m SO happy I found this place 😭✨
Honestly… I could NEVER find a groomer that I truly liked or one that gave me the haircut style I actually wanted for my dog🥲

A few friends kept recommending this place,so I finally booked a full grooming for my dog Yau Mei 🩵And WOWWW. I’m not even exaggerating, this is the FIRST time my dog has ever come out of a grooming appointment in London looking EXACTLY how I imagined 😭😭❤️

Biggest shoutout and THANK YOU to Mari👸🏻!! Seriously, you can tell she put so much time, effort and patience into everything. The cut is SO clean, the shape is perfect,I swear Mari must have worked magic because I’m genuinely obsessed with how she turned out!!

Thank you so so much again 🙏🏻 I’m beyond grateful and I will 10000000% be coming back. Highly recommend if you want your dog to look cute and clean 🐕.

I’ve always loved this place, but a recent misunderstanding about my regular bookings left me feeling very let down. Thankfully, they reached out and completely sorted it. It’s rare to find a business that admits a mistake and goes out of their way to keep a regular customer.

My most recent visit was the worst. They gave me a groomer I'd never seen before a guy named Fred. First time trying him, and honestly? Probably the last.…

When I picked up my dog, I found a long, deep cut on her belly. It's been nearly a month now, and there's still a little scab it hasn't fully healed. She was also really unhappy for days after the groom.

I contacted the new owners straight away just to let them know what happened, and to say I didn't want Fred next time. I also told them I was disappointed！

Their response shocked me.

No apology. No offer to fix it. Instead, they basically said: "If you're disappointed, find another groomer."!

So after 10 years since this place first opened they told me to leave. My first dog was groomed here until she passed away, and I still kept coming back because I trusted them. This is how they treat loyal customers? My dogs are family. If I see they're injured ，Shouldn't I say it out?

Actually this isn't even the first time one of my dogs has been hurt here since they changed owners

I've also seen other reviews mentioning possible racial discrimination from the new owners. After this experience, I wouldn't be surprised.

If your dog gets hurt here, don't expect them to care. They won't help. They'll just show you the door.

We won't be going back anymore. Please think twice for your dog's safety.
terrible pet store! poor skill！They hurt someone's dog and didn't even apologize. I'll stay away. The new owner is so rude, arrogant ,treating people differently.

I have been a loyal customer Bow Wow for many years, dating back to the wonderful previous owners, starting their business in a tiny premises on Little Russell Street.

For years, I was not just a client, but a vocal advocate. I recommended them confidently to countless friends and shared positive experiences on my social media, as they were genuinely the best pet grooming business with the 2 wonderful previous owners - Taro and Jason.

Since the ownership change over a year or so, the decline in both care standards and client respect has been shocking.

The Incidents:

One of my dogs developed an ear infection after grooming.
Few Months later, my other dog came home with a visible cut on her belly after grooming.

The Real Problem: Their Response.
I contacted them privately to alert them—not to ask for anything, but so they could prevent future harm. Their reply was a masterclass in avoiding accountability.

They never apologized or admitted their faults.
They reframed the issue as a “breakdown of your trust in us,” subtly shifting blame onto me, the concerned customer, instead of addressing their safety lapses.

They offered no solution, no plan for improvement, but ultimately suggested I find another groomer. The message was clear: they would rather let a long-term client leave than seriously investigate or fix what went wrong.

The front desk lady, has been consistently rude and impatient, which starkly contrasts with the warm, dog-loving atmosphere of the past.
Core Values: I no longer believe they genuinely love or prioritize the dogs. Under previous management, you felt your pet was cared for. Now, it feels transactional, and when things go wrong, defensive.

It is clear that under the new ownership, both the service quality and after care have significantly declined.
What was once a trusted and beloved pets salon built by the previous owners over many years is now losing the very community that supported it - I’m not the only one who has experienced such treatment under new ownership.
When a business chooses to dismiss long‑standing clients rather than addressing clients’ concerns, it speaks volumes about its priorities.
I’d strongly advise any pet owner to avoid this business - it is simply not worth the risk to your dog’s wellbeing or your own peace of mind.

100/10 – The BEST groomers in London!

Mari has been grooming our pup Rhubarb (aka Rhuby) since she was a tiny fluffball, and her care, technique, and gentle approach are absolutely impeccable. Rhuby absolutely adores Mari! She gets so excited every time we arrive at Bow Wow and always comes home looking adorable with the cutest, fluffiest haircut.

We visit every 6-8 weeks, and the consistency and quality of care have been outstanding. Mari and the entire team, including Taro-san, are incredibly kind, professional, and welcoming. The pricing is also very fair and competitive, especially considering the level of service.

To anyone wondering: In my opinion, they don’t cause “infections” or give “bad haircuts” as long as you keep up with your dog’s grooming routine too. They’re not magicians (though to us, they basically are!). As a dog owner, you need to do your part… regular brushing and maintenance at home make all the difference.

To us, Mari and everyone at the shop/salon is 100/10!!
